explanation: Merged main (#30, #31) into the co-detection client branch. From this branch: the gated co-expression card reaches the loopback HypoMap service only through src/search/hypomap/codetection.ts, which validates responses, fails closed when source_export_manifest_sha256 or the cohort disagrees with the pinned export, resolves service gene positions against the static search index, checks pooled totals and returns ready, partial, unsupported or rejected unions; unsupported datasets stay listed and become marked CSV rows, and useLoad replaces the duplicated load/retry effects. From main: loadBaselineTeaser projects the survey NeuroSeq results as source groups (BaselineTeaser carries groups), and atlas.ts says why it keeps its own transport.
